interpretation: Quiescent CCR7-associated CD4 state derived predominantly from source cluster T02.
Second T02-derived CD4 state characterized by ANKRD55, LRRN3, IGF1R and related quiescent-memory markers.
Memory CD4 state containing T06- and T09-derived cells and expressing part of the published T09 marker program.
FUT7+, TNFRSF4+ and TNFRSF18+ memory CD4 state showing the strongest combined evidence of T09 association and CNS-homing activity.
Highly cytotoxic effector state defined by CX3CR1, FGFBP2, GZMH, GZMB and ADGRG1.
CD8 state with low cytotoxic activity and a naive or central-memory transcriptional profile.
Effector-memory CD8 state characterized by GZMK, CCL5, EOMES and CRTAM.
Innate-like T-cell state defined by KLRB1, SLC4A10, ZBTB16, IL18RAP and NCR3.
Canonical regulatory state defined by FOXP3, IL2RA, CTLA4, TIGIT and RTKN2.
T-cell-associated population with a strong NK-like program including KLRC1, TYROBP, FCER1G and PTGDS.
Cross-lineage functional state defined by IFIT1, IFIT3, IFI44L, RSAD2, OAS1, MX1 and ISG15.
